Recruitment Overview

Exciting opportunities await in the co-operative sector. The U.P. Co-Operative Institutional Service Board (UPCISB) invites applications for the Combined Co-operative Banking, Non-Banking and Technical Services Examination 2026. Aspiring candidates can submit online applications from April 25, 2026, to May 15, 2026. To ensure a smooth process, review the official UPCISB notification for details on exam syllabus, eligibility criteria, age requirements, fees, and more. Stay informed and apply now to embark on a rewarding career in co-operative services.

Alternatively, candidates with a degree in BE, B.Tech, BCA, MCA, BBA, or MBA in relevant fields like banking, finance, or HR are also eligible. A pass in O Level exams is also accepted.
